$comment: Map ICAO type designators to glTF/GLB files in this folder. Types without an entry use the procedural placeholder for their class. Model space: +Z forward (nose), +Y up, +X left wing, meters, origin near the center of gravity; use scale/rotationDeg/offset to adapt other conventions. Only add models you are licensed to redistribute (see README, Aircraft models). `classes` gives a fallback model per aircraft class; `fit` ([length, span] in meters as transformed) stretches a model to each type's real dimensions.
